title.en: An Act Fixing the Salaries of Judges of the Courts of Agrarian Relations, Circuit Criminal Courts and Juvenile and Domestic Relations Courts and for Other Purposes
title.orig: An Act Fixing the Salaries of Judges of the Courts of Agrarian Relations, Circuit Criminal Courts and Juvenile and Domestic Relations Courts and for Other Purposes

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1969/ra_6032_1969.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The annual salary of Regional District Judges of the Courts of Agrarian Relations, and the Judges of the Circuit Criminal Courts and the Juvenile and Domestic Relations Courts is hereby fixed at twenty-three thousand pesos; and that of the Executive Judge of the Courts of Agrarian Relations at Twenty-four thousand pesos.

Such sum as maybe necessary is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to provide for the salary increase authorized in Section one hereof.
All laws or parts thereof inconsistent with the provisions of this Act are hereby amended accordingly.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, August 4, 1969.
